mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Coppock Curve zero crossing identifies a reversal in weighted medium/long-cycle momentum; follow the new sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when Coppock crosses strictly above zero; short when it crosses strictly below zero
mechanism.why_distinct: Coppock adds 11- and 14-period close ROCs and applies a linearly weighted moving average over ten completed observations. It is not a single return sum, price-average crossover, regression, range path, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse weighted dual-cycle momentum zero crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.roc: 100*(current close/close n completed bars earlier-1), n=11 and 14, requiring continuous source bars
features.coppock: causal WMA(10) of roc_sum with oldest weight 1 and newest weight 10, invalid across gaps
features.event: current finite nonzero Coppock sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Coppock(11,14,10) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no periods, weights, threshold, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Edwin S. Coppock canonical Coppock Curve convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: WMA(10) of ROC(11)+ROC(14), with linearly increasing weights 1 through 10
external_basis.selection_use: published periods, weighting, and zero-line direction only; no incidence or outcomes
